utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Mr. Stojanovic, what shall we do?

utterances.speaker: MR. STOJANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I have also been caught off guard a little. Thanks to the spirit of cooperation of the opposing party. Our next witness did not ask for any protective measures, Ranko Dzokic, and because of the arrangements with the VW unit he will be here this afternoon. He does not have a direct flight from Belgrade. He's travelling via Vienna. So we will have him here in the courtroom only tomorrow afternoon. But with your permission, Your Honours, maybe this is a good opportunity for me to give you some details about our forthcoming schedule.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes, of course. I'm very sorry to hear that we'll lose at least two sessions of today. As you know, we are somehow behind schedule, and during this week things -- the Milosevic case is not on, we will have the availability of the courtroom and all the facilities. But anyway, please brief us about your schedule.

utterances.speaker: MR. STOJANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. As we have indicated at the beginning of our case, we planned for the following four witnesses, Vukotic, Maric, Bojanovic, and the witness who testified yesterday and today be completed by today. Tomorrow, we have one witness. On Thursday, we will have two witnesses, Minja Radovic and Brano Djuric, members of the 4th Engineers Company of the Zvornik Brigade. And on Friday, we will call a witness who is scheduled to testify for the whole day. So in accordance with the previous list we planned to complete our case with these witnesses which would be fully in accordance with the schedule that we presented earlier to the Court. All other witnesses will be very brief. Their testimonies will be quite short and will relate to specific individual counts of the indictment. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: With respect to one other witness that was on Mr. Stojanovic's list of witnesses, as I understand, one of the videolink witnesses, an agreement has been reached between the Prosecution and Mr. Stojanovic with respect to one portion of his statement coming in. And in light of that portion of the statement and in light of the other witness that will be available via videolink as it would appear, we -- and in light of the fact that we had already withdrawn this witness from our witness list, the Court should be aware that we certainly will not be asking for this witness, that would be Mr. Vasic, to be appearing by videolink. So that would be a savings of some time as well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much for your cooperation. Thank you. Yes, Mr. McCloskey.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Just one more issue: We have spoken to Mr. Stojanovic about his military expert. And as with Mr. Karnavas's military expert, we will not be objecting to the entry of the report, and I believe Mr. Stojanovic is then agreeing not to call that witness either. So that's another person that has been dealt with.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. I'm very glad to hear that. I believe that both parties showed their cooperation with the good faith. We still have time left, so could we come to an ex parte hearing because we want to hear the reports from Mr. Karnavas as well as from Blagojevic himself about the contacts between them and to see what's the result on that. Do you have any objections, Mr. McCloskey? I think the best way is to conduct it in private session, ex parte hearing, because it may touch upon the sensitive relationship between the counsel and his client.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Yes. Absolutely, we agree. So the Prosecution then will take its leave.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much for your cooperation. Well, there's a suggestion that maybe the best way is to have a short break. Yes, Mr. Stojanovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. STOJANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, since Mr. McCloskey believes that they should perhaps leave the courtroom because of this meeting, we also think that it would perhaps be a good idea for our team to withdraw as well in light of the procedure. But please, you make the ruling.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, we have a break for 15 minutes, and we'll resume at 9.30, only with Mr. Blagojevic and his counsel, Mr. Karnavas.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 14th day of July, 2004, at 2.15 p.m. 19 20 21 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 9.16 a.m.,
